name: t0/greedy
why: Greedy on BOTH arms, so the pair is single-variable. NOTE: an earlier draft of this file claimed the greedy profile had been confirmed at the run's own 32000 budget. It had not -- the node was serving other traffic at the time and only the arm-switch probe was run. That claim is withdrawn; what IS confirmed at 32000 on hard tasks is the effort setting below.

arm_switch.mechanism: reasoning_effort (B4_OFF_MECH=reasoning_effort): off arm sends none, on arm sends medium. chat_template_kwargs also works on this model, but B4_THINK_EFFORT is only honoured under the reasoning_effort mechanism (b3.py:238) -- under template the effort would be silently dropped and the ON arm would run at the vendor default again.
arm_switch.evidence: BOTH switches work on this model -- a third pattern. reasoning_effort=none zeroes the trace (556ch -> 0ch) and chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false also zeroes it. Compare: Nemotron 3.5 on LM Studio GGUF honours reasoning_effort and silently drops chat_template_kwargs; Nemotron 3 Super on this same vLLM node is the exact inverse. Three models, three behaviours, so the switch is a property of the model and its template, not of the backend.
arm_switch.effort_scale: none/low/medium are accepted; reasoning_effort=high is REJECTED with HTTP 400. low and medium both produce 308ch and are indistinguishable on this probe. The unqualified ON arm produces 556ch -- MORE than low or medium but not a runaway, so this model does not repeat the Qwen3.8-27B xhigh inheritance that projected 79 hours on MLX. The ON arm therefore sends nothing and takes the model's own default, which is what the arm is meant to measure.

effort_choice.why: The model card documents reasoning_effort as defaulting to xhigh -- the MAXIMUM -- with xhigh/medium/low supported; 'high' is rejected with HTTP 400. An unqualified ON arm therefore runs at maximum effort, and it showed: 6 of the first 20 tasks burned the entire 32000-token budget and returned no answer (30%), projecting 13-16h. A controlled comparison on 4 hard tasks at the same 32000 budget gave 0/4 capped at medium, 92s/task, projecting 2.7h. This is the same failure and the same fix as Qwen3.8-27B, whose unqualified arm projected 79h on MLX and which at medium scored 58 -> 82, the tier lead.
effort_choice.caveat: The arm therefore measures the model at medium effort, not at its shipped default. That is a deliberate choice and is labelled in the results: at the default the arm is not measurable inside this tier's 32000-token budget, which the vendor's own guidance explains -- it recommends up to 262144 tokens for reasoning content, 8x this tier's floor.
effort_choice.instrumentation_note: A first pass at this comparison reported 0 reasoning characters at every effort level, which would have meant medium disables thinking entirely. That was a bug in the probe, not the model: this server returns the trace in `reasoning`, and the probe read only `reasoning_content`. The harness itself reads `reasoning` first (b3.py:338) and is unaffected.
